capabilities: Show due, overdue, done, and upcoming tasks in four board sections
Check tasks in place and write a done date back to the source line
Group tasks by project file with overdue and pending counts
Display milestone badges counting days from a start date
Jump from a task row to its source note
disambiguation: Not a daily-notes or journaling tool; it is a sidebar dashboard that reads and checks off task lines already written in your notes.
extras: Bilingual English/Chinese README with Chinese notes under each setting label; the listing notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; uses Dataview inline field syntax but does not require the Dataview plugin, network access, or a database.
intentEvidence: Diary / note templates often embed a dataviewjs dashboard in the note body.
motivation: The author moved the dashboard logic out of note templates into a native panel so it opens instantly without the Dataview index wait.
problem: Embedding a dataviewjs dashboard in a diary note forces a wait for Dataview to build its index and re-render on every open.

relations.evidence: Daily Overview moves that logic into a native plugin view: it reads your Markdown with the Obsidian API

summary: Right-sidebar dashboard that lists today's due, overdue, done, and upcoming tasks plus per-project progress, read directly from Markdown task lines.
